title: PROVISIONAL WHOLESALE PRICE INDEX, OUTPUT PRODUCER PRICE INDEX, AND TRIAL INPUT PRODUCER PRICE INDEX FOR THE MONTH OF OCTOBER 2026, AND FINAL INDEX FOR THE MONTH OF AUGUST 2026
subtitle: Provisional Wholesale Price Index (Base Year 2022-23) for the month of October 2026
body_text: Key highlights of WPI (Base Year 2022-23) for October 2026 All India Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation for October 2026 is 12.29 per cent on year-on-year (YoY) basis, compared to 11.39 per cent in September 2026. The index for All Commodities for October 2026 stands at 113.3, whereas it was 112.5 in September 2026. YoY inflation rates for major groups, namely, Primary Articles, Fuel and Power, and Manufactured Products are 9.24 per cent, 32.84 per cent, and 9.54 per cent, respectively in October 2026, compared to 8.67 per cent, 25.85 per cent, and 9.76 per cent, respectively in September 2026. The indices for Primary Articles, Fuel and Power, and Manufactured Products are 120.6, 115.7, and 110.2, respectively, in October 2026, whereas they were 120.3, 110.5, and 110.2, respectively, in September 2026. Across groups, ‘Mineral Oils (containing Petroleum Products) ’, ‘Crude Petroleum and Natural Gas’, ‘Electricity’, ‘Food Articles’, ‘Manufacture of Basic Metals’, ‘Manufacture of Chemicals and Chemical Products’, ‘Manufacture of Food Products’, ‘Non-Food Articles’, ‘Manufacture of Textiles’, and ‘Manufacture of Rubber and Plastic Products’ have been drivers of WPI inflation in October 2026. WPI Food Index (weight=24.99 per cent): The Food Index consists of ‘Food Articles’ from Primary Articles major group, and ‘Manufacture of Food Products’ from Manufactured Products major group. It observed a YoY inflation of 8.58 per cent in October 2026, compared to 8.66 per cent in September 2026. Monthly indices and Inflation Rate (in per cent) for All commodities and Major Groups, along with major group-wise contribution for the past months are presented in the charts below. Chart 1: WPI Index and Inflation Rate for All Commodities Chart 2: WPI Index of Major Groups Chart 3: Inflation Rate across Major Groups Chart 4: Major Group-Wise contribution to Inflation The final index for the month of August 2026 remains unchanged at 110.8 as compared to the provisional index. Accordingly, the WPI inflation rate for August 2026 also remains unchanged at 9.92 per cent (final). The final index of WPI (Base Year 2022-23) for the month of August 2026 has been compiled with a weighted response rate of 99.37 per cent. The provisional index of WPI (Base Year 2022-23) for the month of October 2026 has been compiled with a weighted response rate of 81.1 per cent. Wholesale Price Index and Year-on-Year (YoY) Inflation Rate for All Commodities, Major Groups, and Groups for the last six months is given at Annexure-I and II respectively. Cumulative WPI for All Commodities, Major Groups, and Groups from April to October for FY 2023-24, FY 2024-25, FY 2025-26, and FY 2026-27 is given at Annexure-III. Cumulative YoY Inflation Rate for All Commodities, Major Groups, and Groups from April to October for FY 2024-25, FY 2025-26, and FY 2026-27 is given at Annexure- IV. Item-wise data pertaining to WPI (Base Year 2022-23) series from April 2023 to October 2026 is available at (https://eaindustry.nic.in/download_data_2223.asp ). Provisional indices of WPI, OPPI, and trial IPPI for a reference month are released on the 14 th of the following month (if it is a working day, else on next working day). Accordingly, release of WPI, Output PPI, and trial Input PPI for the month of November 2026 will be on Monday, 14 th December 2026.
